notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-start-options (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): START options beyond INTERVAL / TIME: the data options RTRANSID / RTERMID / QUEUE and RETRIEVE's ENVDEFERR, RETRIEVE with no INTO, AFTER / AT, INVREQ's RESP2, a REQID reused with FROM (IOERR); RUN TRANSID's child task. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: data-options
scenarios.why: START FROM with RTRANSID, RTERMID and QUEUE: GT22's one RETRIEVE gets the data and all three values

scenarios.name: envdeferr
scenarios.why: START with FROM only: GT22's RETRIEVE also names RTRANSID / RTERMID / QUEUE, so ENVDEFERR

scenarios.name: no-into
scenarios.why: START with RTRANSID and no FROM: still a data record; GT23 RETRIEVEs it with no INTO, then ENDDATA

scenarios.name: after-at
scenarios.why: AFTER MINUTES(1), AFTER 0 h 0 m 30 s, AT 10:45 and TIME(250000) at 10:00: tasks at 10:00:30, 10:01, 10:45; the last is tomorrow's

scenarios.name: invreq-resp2
scenarios.why: INTERVAL(70), AFTER HOURS(1) MINUTES(60), AFTER SECONDS(360000), AFTER HOURS(100): INVREQ with RESP2 6, 5, 6, 4; nothing starts

scenarios.name: run-transid
scenarios.why: RUN TRANSID('GT24') CHILD attaches a child task that runs (no terminal); RUN of an undefined transaction is TRANSIDERR RESP2 1

scenarios.name: reqid-ioerr
scenarios.why: the same REQID twice, both with FROM: the second START is IOERR; only the first runs

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE/IF arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
